text.title: FreshDrop profile: busy family buyer, 30–40, with 2+ children
text.about: 34, marketing manager, two kids; spends about 60 000 a month on groceries; orders weekly
text.context: Orders on the phone during the evening commute, for the whole week ahead
text.value: Wants reliable slots and fresh produce; success means a complete order on time
text.problems: Missing items and late couriers after 21:00; loses about 40 minutes a week to fixing orders
text.persona: Olga: plans the family week in one order
text.implications: Fix missing items first; no extra categories for her; check on-time rate every week
